thread_text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in node provisioning failures across us-west-2. Error pattern: image pull auth failures (401) and rate-limited pulls (429) for NVIDIA/CUDA images (dockerhub + nvcr). 70% of recent provisioning attempts failing. Alerting SRE oncall.

maria: seeing this in the autoscaler logs too. nodes failing at 'docker pull nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime' with 401/429. Rolling retries not helping.

daniel: +1, I can repro locally against our provisioner:

```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/node-provisioner.log
ERROR: pull for nvidia/cuda:11.8 failed: status code 429
Cause: external registry throttling
```

sachin: Docker Hub token rotation last night might have hit shared quotas. Also NVCR has intermittent auth gateway errors reported upstream. Quick question: do we have a cached AMI for GPU nodes we can fall back to?

emma: we do have prebuilt AMIs with the image baked in, but autoscaler prefers fresh pulls for latest tag. We can change the launch config to use the prebaked AMI temporarily. That should avoid pulls entirely.

maria: temporary mitigation plan: (1) switch autoscaler launch config to gpu-prebaked-ami-2026-02 (2) add registry mirror - `registry.internal.redwood/proxy` (3) rotate DockerHub token to a lower-consumption token and enable mirror pull-through. Who can update the launch config now?

daniel: I can do the launch config change and trigger a scale-in/scale-out to replace bad nodes. Doing it now.

sachin: i'll open a mirror pull-through on the registry proxy and push a mirror of the CUDA image there. Command: 

```
registryctl mirror create --src "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8" --dst "registry.internal.redwood/nvidia/cuda:11.8-mirror"
```

nate: taking oncall for the handoff. @maria i'm onwatch, escalate to me if anything customer-facing pops.

maria: thanks @nate. support-bot, please run impact query: how many customer node launches failed in last 30m and which customers?

support-bot: impact query results: 42 failed launches in 30m across 9 customers. Top affected: acme-inc (12), synthly (8), dataforge (6). Most failures are transient; automated retries succeeded for ~15 of 42 within 10m.

emma: update: switched autoscaler to gpu-prebaked-ami-2026-02, kicked a graceful drain on failing nodes. New nodes launch and register successfully (no pull). System reports nodes healthy.

daniel: mirror push completed, provisioning now set to prefer internal mirror path. Example fallback in launch script: `IMAGE=registry.internal.redwood/nvidia/cuda:11.8-mirror || docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8`

sachin: still seeing a small tail of 401s for legacy fleets where launch config didn't update. I'll patch those ASGs now. ETA 10m.

maria: customer impact summary so far (preliminary): delayed deployments for ~3% of launches in us-west-2, median delay ~8m, peak failures ~42 launches across 9 customers. No known data loss, no active shortened SLAs yet but this is high risk.

nate: next steps: (1) finish ASG patches (sachin), (2) keep mirror pull-through for 24h and monitor token usage (daniel), (3) follow up with vendor (Docker Hub/NVCR) for rate-limit/auth incidents and record ticket IDs (maria). I'll own the incident timeline and postmortem.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers with templated message (opt-out).

daniel: metrics/alerts to create: a) image-pull-401-rate > 0.5% per-region b) provisioning-fail-rate > 1% for 10m -> page SRE.

maria: handing off to @nate for the incident lead. If anything regresses ping me.

nate: taking incident lead now. Updated status: mitigation applied, nodes recovering, internal mirror in place, rotations in progress. I'll keep this thread open and update every 15m or on major changes. :white_check_mark:
